data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root 'j-m-l', meaning 'to flow'. Jumalaa refers to a gentle wave, an allusion to the tranquil nature of the sea. In Islamic tradition, the sea is a symbol of God's infinite mercy and protection. The name Jumalaa carries the meaning “Gentle Wave” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Jumalaa usually hope their child will grow to embody gentle wave and live with faith, good character and purpose.
